basic_info.description: Rare San Francisco Penthouse Condo located in The Shipyard at Hunter's Point, city living at its finest! Located on the roof of the Merchant Building, this is one of the few Shipyard buildings that has an elevator. This turnkey corner rooftop condo has spectacular views of San Francisco, other features include a Balcony off the Living Room, Bosch Appliances, Quartz slab countertops, and porcelain tile floors. Building Amenities include assigned garage parking, a rooftop seating area with gas grill, bicycle storage room and a fitness center!
